725:t_117:1.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Reflect on your evil deeds in the depths of darkness! Ye are guilty!」

725:t_118:0.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Shut up about all your darkness! I don't wanna hear that crap!」

725:t_118:1.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Let's do this! This is where we say goodbye to your gloomy asses!!」

725:t_119:0.en:
$$アマタ$$
「No matter how hard you try to drive us into despair, I have the love between $$ミコノ$$ and me!」

725:t_119:1.en:
$$アマタ$$
「As long as I have that, I'm not afraid of darkness! We'll fight beyond life and death!!」

725:t_120:0.en:
$$シンジ$$
「I'll... move forward... I want to...!」

725:t_120:1.en:
$$シンジ$$
「Whatever you say, I... will fight!」

725:t_120:2.en:
$$カヲル$$
(That's right, $$シンジ$$. Live by your own will.)

725:t_121:0.en:
$$ガロード$$
「It's laughable that filthy bastards like you call yourselves gods!」

725:t_121:1.en:
$$ガロード$$
「I'll show you humanity's hidden strength... Our power to believe in the future!!」

725:t_122:0.en:
$$ロラン$$
「You stole people's freedom and peace by force. You can't possibly be gods!」

725:t_122:1.en:
$$ロラン$$
「You're our enemies... the enemies of all living things! I'll stop you here!!」

725:t_123:0.en:
$$アムロ$$
「If we lose to you, swallowed by darkness, humanity can never move forward!」

725:t_123:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
「We'll overcome the darkness! We'll advance into the future!!」

725:t_124:0.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「We've fought all this way while overcoming our past!」

725:t_124:1.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「We won't submit to darkness! We know there's something beyond it!!」

725:t_125:0.en:
$$バナージ$$
「You seek to cut off our possibilities... our future...!」

725:t_125:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
「We'll resist with everything we have! We'll protect what matters to us from your darkness!!」

725:t_126:0.en:
$$刹那$$
「You refuse to understand others and seek to rule everything by force...!」

725:t_126:1.en:
$$刹那$$
「We'll break through you! That's our fight!!」

725:t_127:0.en:
$$シン$$
「Now I understand everything! As long as bastards like you exist, war will never end!」

725:t_127:1.en:
$$シン$$
「Like hell we'll fall into darkness! What we want is a peaceful future!!」

725:t_128:0.en:
$$キラ$$
「Everyone has a sad past... But we won't let it defeat us...!」

725:t_128:1.en:
$$キラ$$
「People go on living, overcoming their past and regrets! That strength won't lose to darkness!!」

725:t_129:0.en:
$$シャア$$
「The man I once was would have been swallowed by your darkness and unable to climb back out...!」

725:t_129:1.en:
$$シャア$$
「But now I am different! Both humanity and I can see the path ahead... the future!」

725:t_130:1.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「I confirm the targets. Our attack targets are the self-proclaimed gods.」

725:t_131:0.en:
$$アルト$$
「My wings turn hope into strength! Though you wouldn't understand that!」

725:t_131:1.en:
$$アルト$$
「Let's do this! We'll fly straight through the darkness!!」

725:t_132:0.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Stop talking crap and listen to my soooong!!」

725:t_132:1.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Then you'll realize how stupid all that talk of darkness is!!」

725:t_133:0.en:
$$レド$$
「It's true that I still regret what I did...!」

725:t_133:1.en:
$$レド$$
「But I won't stop moving forward because of it! On Earth, I learned that there is a future... and what it means to live!!」

725:t_134:0.en:
$$宗介$$
「You thought your selfish judgments and phony magic tricks would break our spirits. You badly miscalculated!」

725:t_134:1.en:
$$宗介$$
「Humans may be weak creatures! But I'll show you that you're far weaker and more foolish than we are!!」

725:t_135:0.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I have something to do before the past can crush me...! That is why I am alive!」

725:t_135:1.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「This life exists to protect the future... In other words, it is the power to strike you down!!」

725:t_136:0.en:
$$キリコ$$
「Despair... The darkness of the heart...」

725:t_136:1.en:
$$キリコ$$
「I'll live beyond it. That's my fight.」

725:t_137:0.en:
$$桂$$
「Sorry, you league of fake gods! We faced the darkness inside us a long time ago!」

725:t_137:1.en:
$$桂$$
「I don't want dimwits who don't even understand that lecturing us about humanity!!」

725:t_138:0.en:
$n
「So everyone overcame hope and despair, just like I did.」

725:t_138:1.en:
$$スズネ$$
「That's what it means to be human.」

725:t_138:2.en:
$n
「All that's left is to beat the bastards who deny the future we're heading toward!」

725:t_138:3.en:
$n
「Get ready, you evil gods! You're going to lose to humans!!」

725:t_139:0.en:
$$カミナ$$
「Show me, $$シモン$$! Show me that spirit of yours!」

725:t_139:1.en:
$$シモン$$
「Yeah! I'm not gonna screw up with Bro watching!」

725:t_139:2.en:
$$シモン$$
「Let's do it! I'll unite Bro's fighting spirit with mine and create the biggest, strongest drill in the universe!!」
